text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to 
breakfast...♪
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I wonder what they'll serve for 
breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A morning at the training camp with a 
refreshing sea breeze. While chatting 
about such things on the way to the dining 
hall...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... dried horse mackerel, seaweed miso 
soup, boiled egg and chicken breast salad, 
and then...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mugitoro rice... Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I was just thinking how delicious it 
looks...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm even hungrier! ...Let's go get 
some food quickly, Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm even hungrier! ...Let's go get 
some food quickly, Sister!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing a hearty breakfast, we 
headed to the training beach all fired up, 
ready for the real deal—or so we thought.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing! Um... Beach huts have so 
many different kinds of food, don't they?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A beach hut?" I wondered, looking ahead 
to find a banner for "Yakisoba Pan" 
fluttering in the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No! I'm okay! Let's start training...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of an exhausting day, on the 
way back from the bath, passing by the 
cafeteria...
Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's been like this all week... B-But 
maybe something will show up next week...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah?! B-Big brother...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah?! B-Big sister...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The voice belonged to Rice Shower, as 
expected. Wondering what she was doing, I 
looked around—
choice_data_list: Were you looking at the menu?
Were you looking at the menu?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yeah. I was wondering what 
tomorrow's breakfast would be. ...Looks 
like it's edamame rice tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... now that Rice knows you're okay, 
she'll head off. Good night...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There she went... I was worried about how 
she seemed before training today, so I 
wanted to talk a bit more, but...
choice_data_list: (She seemed to be sighing earlier too...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think back to the times when she was 
acting strange. "Breakfast," "beach hut," 
"menu"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next morning.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list: Rice, are you having breakfast now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, dear brother. Yeah. 
That's right, but...
choice_data_list:
Actually, I prepared something else— wanna 
eat outside?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, Onee-sama. Yeah. That's 
right, but...
choice_data_list:
Actually, I prepared something else— wanna 
eat outside?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah! Sandwiches...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“Still... why? When we have food at the 
training camp...”
choice_data_list:
Rice, you prefer bread in the morning... 
right?

Rice, you're a bread-for-breakfast 
person... aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! ...Rice loves cooked rice, but in 
the morning, I'm strictly a bread person!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was spring, one year ago, when I 
learned she prefers bread in the morning. 
Eating rice every morning must be 
demoralizing for her. ...Thinking that, I 
went ahead and prepared it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother, you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Onee-sama, you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...! Thank you for the meal—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *nibble*...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...It's delicious! It's Big Brother's 
honey mustard sandwich...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...It's delicious! It's Big Sister's 
honey mustard sandwich...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The grilled summer vegetables are so 
sweet. The chicken has a refreshing herb 
flavor too, and goes so well with the 
honey mustard...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —...Slowpoke.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... It was just so delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It was just... so, so delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, among Rice's favorite 
picture books, there's one called 'Good 
Morning, Bakery.'"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's a story about various customers 
coming to buy "Good Morning Bread" baked 
by tiny fairies.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Good Morning Bread" is magical bread, and 
when you eat it, morning comes to your 
heart with a bright "Good morning!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the "Good Morning Bread", even 
if something sad happens... A happy 
morning will come for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Rice eats bread in the morning 
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever something sad happened, I'd get 
energized by 'Good Morning Bread' so I 
could keep doing my best.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —But, that was all there was to it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I just couldn't bring myself to say I 
wanted bread for breakfast for a silly 
reason like that..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ... Fufu, so yummy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's so... good...! Waaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It hits me once again. To her, "eating" 
isn't just about nutrition... It's a 
precious time that nourishes her delicate 
heart as well.
choice_data_list: I made a whole bunch, so eat up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Yeah...! Thank you, big 
brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Yeah...! Thank you, big 
sister...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eat some with me, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's eat together, Big Sister!
